INDEPENDENT. SOURCE-LINKED. PLAYER-FOCUSED.

Your progress stays with you.

Local bookmarks and checklists

Saved guides and firearm checkmarks on hellraiserrevival.help use your browser’s local storage. No account is needed, and this site does not send that progress to a server. Clearing this site’s browser data removes it. A different browser or device has a separate list.

Search and analytics

Guide search runs in your browser. On the published site we measure aggregate usage with Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity; these scripts may set cookies or use similar browser storage, and they are disabled on local development copies so testing is never recorded. We do not run advertising or sell data. Fonts and artwork are served with the site. The hosting provider may process ordinary request logs to serve pages.

External sources

When you open an external source, that website’s own privacy policy applies.
